title: An Automatic Framework for Nasal Esthetic Assessment by ResNet Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: Automated nasal landmark/symmetry framework was compared against otolaryngologist ratings; source reports close association and visualization of asymmetry, but no independent validation or clinical-outcome benefit. This is a limited measurement result. The result is limited to this study setting and is not evidence of benefit in deployment.
